claim.purpose: Prevent partition-local llvm-cov report crashes without weakening coverage

initial.title: [v0.91.8][CI] Prevent partition-local llvm-cov report crashes from failing hosted coverage
initial.goal: Make hosted authoritative coverage collect profiles per partition and render only the intended combined reports.
initial.required_outcome: Hosted coverage no longer fails because a redundant partition-local llvm-cov report crashes, while test scope and coverage gates remain unchanged.
authority_boundary: Issue #5602 owns only authoritative coverage orchestration
Issue #5336 and PR #5599 own Runtime v3 planning content
initial.task_boundary: Add supported no-report profile collection to partition commands and strengthen focused contracts only.
deliverables: Focused command-shape and failure-semantics regression coverage
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Every partition still executes its full selected test set
AC-2: Partition commands collect profiles without rendering reports
AC-3: Explicit combined ADL and Runtime reports remain authoritative
AC-4: Existing thresholds and fail-closed behavior remain unchanged
AC-5: Focused contracts pass with build artifacts on /Volumes/FastWork
dependencies: PR #5599 run 29773292101 job 88477335280 retained failure evidence
initial.plan_summary: Add --no-report to partitioned profile collection, lock the command contract, validate locally, review, and publish.

steps.action: Add no-report profile collection to every authoritative coverage partition
Strengthen focused regression contracts and validate on /Volumes/FastWork
Review, publish, and integrate the bounded repair

risks: A command path could omit no-report
Explicit final reporting could accidentally be weakened
A test could assert text without exercising failure semantics
invariants: Test selectors and partition count are unchanged
stop_conditions: The repair requires lowering coverage or skipping tests
review_prompts: Does every partition collect profiles with --no-report?
Are the explicit combined reports and gates unchanged?
Does the contract prove partition failures still fail closed?
operator_constraints: Use typed C-SDLC v2 and ADL owner binaries only
Never use raw gh or AWS
Never weaken or bypass the coverage gate

validation_lanes.proof_role: Prove profile-only partition collection and unchanged combined reporting

initial.failure_policy: Fail closed if any test selector, threshold, explicit report, or non-PR failure behavior is weakened.
